notes: All 110 files of the list were searched with text searches and with a Python AST scan. 15 files hold an environment read or write; the other 95 hold none. The names came from these searches: os.environ and os.getenv calls, subscripts and 'in' tests; env= dictionaries; monkeypatch.setenv and delenv; setdefault, pop and update calls on environment copies; shell variable expansions inside script text that the tests write to disk. Three tests write scripts that read the environment: perfetto/test_perfetto.py (fake traced, traced_probes, perfetto, runtron, mkdir, rmdir, sudo; 34 FAKE_* names), t/proxy/test_rzproxy.py (stub_rinzler_proxy; STUB_MODE, STUB_RUN_FILE_DIR) and config/test_model_definitions.py (fake python3; ROUTER_CALLS). No other code generator in this area emits code that reads the environment: fpga-reg/gen_reg_hpp.py, config/model_definitions.py and the ingest export tools were checked for getenv, environ and ENV{. perfetto/fuse-capture reads no environment variable; its docstring only mentions TRON_TRACE_CATEGORIES as the format of the categories field. t/proxy/test_rzproxy.py:1670 asserts that proxy_env() does not set TRON_PROXY_VOCAB_SIZE; the comment says its C++ reader was removed, so the name is not an entry. Names that this area only sets, with the reader in another area: TRON_GOLDEN_TOKENS, RZ_SYSTEM_START_DATE, RZ_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS (rinzler_proxy), TRON_PROXY_WEIGHTS_ROOT (t/proxy/run_suite.sh), PERFETTO_BIN_DIR, PERFETTO_HOME, TRON_RUNTRON, TRACE_DEST_IP, TRON_PERFETTO_CONFIG, TRON_PERFETTO_READY_TIMEOUT, TRON_TRACEFS, USER (perfetto/tronperf, perfetto/wrapper, perfetto/launcher-common), WEIGHTS_ROOT, EXPORT_DIR, PLUGIN_DIR, COVERAGE, EXPORT_ARGS (ingest/build-all.sh), TRON_HW_SAMPLER (src/pos/hwperf.cpp).
